paper_title: g-C₃N₄-based smart nanocatalysts for photocatalytic cancer therapy

questions.question: What are the limitations of conventional cancer treatments, and why does the paper investigate g-C₃N₄-based smart nanocatalysts for photocatalytic cancer therapy?
What role do g-C₃N₄-based nanocatalysts play in photocatalytic cancer therapy, and what are their primary therapeutic mechanisms?
What surface engineering strategies are discussed to improve the photocatalytic performance of g-C₃N₄, and how do heteroatom doping, heterojunction construction, and defect engineering work?
How do g-C₃N₄-based nanocatalysts affect light absorption, electron–hole separation, and reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, and how are these processes related?
What quantitative performance metrics and experimental results are reported for g-C₃N₄-based nanocatalysts, and what numerical values and experimental conditions are associated with each result?
